facts.text: TANK’s Senior Transportation program requires riders to be at least 67 and show proof of age using photo ID on every ride. This is a separate program from the fixed-route reduced-fare rules.
facts.quote: To be eligible for service, a passenger must be age 67 or older. Proof of age (photo ID) must be shown each time you ride.

facts.text: For Senior Transportation, both the origin and destination must be within TANK’s service area. Published service is Monday–Friday, excluding holidays, 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Confirm the actual addresses and any mobility-device or boarding assistance needs when scheduling.
facts.quote: Origin and Destination must both be inside TANK Service Area- No Service provided outside of TANK Service Area Monday through Friday, excluding holidays 8:00 am to 5:00 pm

facts.text: Senior Transportation accepts medical appointments, essential trips such as grocery or pharmacy visits, and facility trips such as senior centers. Rides are first-come, can be denied when demand exceeds capacity, and may prioritize those categories in that order. Recreation and social trips are excluded.
facts.quote: Only the following trip types are eligible: Medical Appointments Essential Services (grocery, pharmacy, etc.) Facility Transportation (Redwood, BAWAC, Senior Centers, etc.) Trips will be provided on a first-come, first-served basis and may be denied at the time of scheduling based on demand. If demand exceeds capacity, trips may be prioritized in the order listed above. Recreation, Social and other trips are not eligible.

facts.text: The Senior Transportation page gives an $8 one-way fare, payable only in cash when boarding. It says tickets and passes are neither sold nor accepted for this service; do not assume the fixed-route app, smart card or fare cap applies.
facts.quote: Fare is $8 one-way. Payment is cash only and is due when the passenger boards the bus. No tickets or passes are sold or accepted.

facts.text: Book Senior Transportation by calling 859-578-6949, Monday–Friday 10 a.m.–5 p.m., up to one week ahead. TANK provides a 30-minute pickup window rather than an exact pickup time. Booking-office hours differ from the program’s travel hours.
facts.quote: Trips can be scheduled by calling 859-578-6949 between 10 a.m. and 5 p.m. Monday-Friday. Trips can be scheduled up to one week in advance. A 30-minute pick-up window will be provided.
